# SOW Spec — Car Brite (new-build)

## Project Summary

Car Brite is a new-build Shopify Hydrogen headless storefront project on the basic plan tier, built as a **second storefront** alongside the client's existing, currently-live Shopify store — the existing Dawn theme must not be modified. The new storefront uses Shopify's Storefront API and Admin API, with the homepage powered by Shopify Metaobjects so the client can manage homepage content without developer help. Total scope: 54 hours / $2,160 USD ($40/hr internal) — corrected 2026-08-31, see Rewrite 6; 45h of this is allocated across Modules 1-5, 9h is a client feedback buffer (Module 6). Target launch: 2026-09-30 (roughly one month from quote date — tight for a custom headless build; see Risks).

The project is fixed-scope, fixed-price, delivered across 5 sprints (Analysis & Kick-Off → Hydrogen Setup → Custom Theme Development → Desktop QA & Responsive → Go-Live). Design phase delivers HTML mockups only (D-DES-01). All client comms route through Ajay Sir (Internal PM). FLAG-004 blocklist captured at intake (partial — see notes).

The HTML design details and HTML mockups are provided for reference purposes only. Please use the provided Home Page and Collection Page `.md` files as design references only.

## Out of Scope

The following are NOT in this SOW:

- Any changes to the existing, live Shopify Dawn theme / storefront
- Multi-region / multi-currency setup (single-region only in this scope)
- Multi-store setup beyond the two storefronts (existing Dawn store + new Hydrogen store)
- Mobile app
- Custom payment gateway integration beyond Shopify's standard checkout
- Custom shipping rules beyond Shopify defaults
- Tax automation beyond Shopify's default tax handling
- Custom CRM integration (Recharge subscription config only; other platforms separate)
- Content writing (client provides; we style)
- Product photography (client provides)
- Logo / brand identity design
- Hosting setup beyond Oxygen configuration (we configure Oxygen; broader hosting decisions are client's)
- Domain registration / DNS beyond propagation at go-live (client handles registration)
- SEO content strategy (technical SEO only; content SEO separate)
- Paid advertising setup (Google Ads, Meta Ads — separate engagement)
- Ongoing maintenance after launch (separate maintenance plan)

---

## Risks & Assumptions

### Assumptions
- The existing Shopify store (Dawn theme) remains fully live and operational throughout, unmodified, while the new Hydrogen storefront is built in parallel
- Client provides Google Analytics tracking code and Recharge account details on schedule
- One primary point of contact on client side, accessible weekly
- Zero-hour sub-items (see Modules 1, 3, 4, 5) are genuinely bundled into adjacent line items and require no separate dev time — confirmed by sales, not independently verified against the spreadsheet's intent

### Risks
- **Bundled zero-hour items (Medium)**: Nine sub-items (Customer Login, Customer Registration, Account Dashboard, Order History, Address Management, Mobile Optimization, GTM Setup, Client QA Support, Post-Launch Fixes) carry no dedicated hours in Modules 1-5. The Module 6 client feedback buffer (9h) is reserved for feedback/revision rounds, NOT for absorbing this risk — if these items need real dev time, that's a separate conversation, not automatic coverage. Monitor at G0.5.
- **Client feedback buffer usage (Low, informational)**: 9h reserved (Module 6, RESOLVED 2026-08-31) for post-feedback revision rounds across Modules 1-5. Track draw-down against `project.json.budget.hours_burned` so it isn't silently exhausted by scope creep disguised as "feedback."
- **Compressed timeline (Medium)**: ~1 month between quote (2026-08-31) and target launch (2026-09-30) for a custom Hydrogen/Oxygen headless build with Metaobjects and Recharge subscription integration. Standard new-build content/credential delays would meaningfully threaten this date.
- **Plan tier vs. scope mismatch (Low, informational)**: "Basic" plan tier is paired with a technically custom scope (headless Hydrogen, Storefront/Admin API, Metaobjects, Oxygen hosting). Sales confirmed basic tier is intentional for now, with upgrade path if needed later.
- **Design revisions risk (Medium)**: 5 homepage revisions; 3 per other page. Scope changes beyond revision count are out of scope.

### Pre-flight gates
- G0 intake gate
- G0.5 audit gate
- G1 plan gate
- G2 design gate
- G3 scaffold gate
- G4 sprint QA
- G5 milestone gate
- G6 pre-launch
